patch_description: Replace greedy+local search with a λ-feasibility binary search: for a candidate max-KVPR λ, pack models via first-fit with constraint load_i + w ≤ λ * (free_i - s). Feasibility is monotone in λ, so binary search finds the minimum λ. Run the same search over multiple candidate orderings (density desc, size desc, w desc, s+w desc) and keep the best feasible placement.
